thread:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multi-region failover observed. Automated traffic-shift triggered from ap-southeast1 -> eu-central1 at 1765019869 due to sustained backend 500s in AP. Affected endpoints: chat-streaming, embeddings-api.

pagerbot: Impact: ~12% of requests routed to fallback region; some long-lived streams tearing (client-side reconnects). Auto-fallback policy TTL=30s.

lina: I'm taking this. oncall-network to eyeball BGP + LB config? paging arjun.

arjun: oncall-network here. checking global load-balancer health and inter-region peering. getting noisy BGP withdraw logs from peering-2.

sally: I'm pulling service traces. I see a cluster of `connection reset by peer` originating from ap nodes 10.200.x.x and the proxy healthcheck failures started right after a rolling update job at 1765019700.

lina: interesting timing. Did the rolling update touch sidecar proxies or node kernel modules? @platform_pm?

platform_pm: our recent image push contained a netfilter change. It was gated but rolled to AP to speed fixes. We rolled 3/12 AZs.

arjun: that matches. Peering observed partial route withdrawal for the AP prefixes; looks like edge nodes dropped adjacency during the drain and the failover automation advertised the fallback prefix before full withdrawal completed -> split-brain routes.

devops_bot: `runbook:regional-failover` engaged by lina. Checkpoint saved.

lina: immediate plan: 1) pause automated failover so no additional announcements; 2) rollback netfilter change in AP sidecar image on remaining nodes; 3) gracefully drain affected nodes and force-advertise stable prefixes from control-plane region.

arjun: pausing failover: `failoverctl pause --reason="BGP convergence race"` -> confirmed.

sally: throttling application retries and enabling 503->retry suppression for streaming endpoints to avoid retry storms.

platform_pm: rolling back image tag `edge-proxy:2026.03.11` -> `edge-proxy:2026.03.05` on AP pools. K8s rollout started. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra set image ds/edge-proxy edge-proxy=edge-proxy:2026.03.05 --record
```

lina: arjun, can you withdraw any stale emergency BGP announcements and force reconverge? We need clean control-plane.

arjun: withdrawing stale ads from peering-2 and peering-3. Running `vtysh -c "clear bgp *"` then re-announce. Watching RIPE/Cloudflare sensors.

arjun: update: BGP state moving to ESTABLISHED for all peers. Public sensors show prefixes converged at 1765019982.

sally: application error rates falling to baseline for non-streaming calls. Streaming still shows a 3% error on reconnects. Those are the long-lived sockets from older clients hitting intermediate nodes that never drained.

lina: starting controlled pod eviction on ap-legacy-nodes group: `kubectl drain ap-legacy-* --force --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60` doing 2 at a time.

platform_pm: autoscaler spun up replacement nodes in AP (4 nodes) to accept pods. Observability shows connections shifting to healthy pods.

cs_lead: CS update: initial customer impact list sent to EU/AP customers on high tier. Some customers reported degraded service during 1765019800-1765019950. We're sending a short incident notice and will follow up with timeline.

arjun: note — discovered root trigger: our failover controller didn't check dataplane adjacency state; it only checked LB health which passed for a subset. Created ticket: INFRA-5102 - failover preflight must include BGP adjacency + route probe checks.

sally: also logging that the rolling update orchestration allowed drains without ensuring BGP quiescence. Another ticket INFRA-5103 to add a pre-drain hook that signals edge peering.

lina: current status: control-plane stable, BGP converged, app error rate ~baseline for sync endpoints, streaming reconnects decreasing. Will keep drains until ap-legacy-nodes are fully rotated.

platform_pm: initiating a post-incident drill: replicating the exact sequence in staging tomorrow at 09:00 UTC. We need a runbook update and a canary gating job to validate BGP/route state before traffic-shift.

sally: handing off monitoring to the next oncall at 1765020060. I'll prepare metrics snapshots and include service-level graphs in the postmortem.

lina: thanks. oncall handoff to arjun in 10m. Before handoff, confirm that `failoverctl` is unpaused with manual approval only.

arjun: confirmed — leaving it paused. Manual-only mode enabled: `failoverctl set-mode manual`.

devops_bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, partial service restoration observed. Severity downgraded P1->P2 at 1765020055. Postmortem ticket PM-2026-03-15-failover-race opened.

cs_lead: closing loop with customers: sending a follow-up email with ETA for postmortem in 48hrs.

lina: handing off to arjun for follow-up RFCs and runbook edits. Im signing out. :white_check_mark:

arjun: will update runbook and coordinate staged drill. Closing slack thread but will post summary in #postmortems when done.
